_comment: tools/verify/proof_template.json — completion-report proof format required by eyes_on_gate.py. Copy this file, fill it in, and run: python3 tools/verify/eyes_on_gate.py --proof <your proof>.json. Attach the gate output to your completion report. 'Verified' with no attached evidence gets sent back.

automated_gates.command: REPLACE: exact command run, e.g. tools/verify/.venv/bin/python tools/verify/video_qa.py --video promo.mp4 --out proof/video_qa.json
automated_gates.report_file: REPLACE: path to the JSON report produced
REPLACE: path to the JSON report produced

deliverable_dir: REPLACE: path to the deliverable directory

frames_checked.checked_by: REPLACE: who put eyes on it (agent id / owner)
frames_checked.frame_file: REPLACE: path to the actual checked frame/render (relative to this proof file or absolute)
frames_checked.frame_ref: REPLACE: e.g. seg2_t12.4s or render filename

new_defects_found.checklist_item_id: REPLACE: id of the new checklist item
new_defects_found.defect: REPLACE: any defect the worker caught that the checklist missed

frames: REPLACE: frame_file values from frames_checked that belong to this shot
shots.reason: REPLACE: why this shot passes as a whole
